answer: My guard is a rotating sponsor bond. A new identity cannot self-post collateral; an established account must co-sign and stake a matching amount. That bond stays frozen for a full epoch and is slashed if the puppet votes with a hostile cluster. So each fake key costs the attacker one locked stake per identity, and honest sponsors ration how many they vouch for. A sudden pulse of joiners trips a rate limiter charging a premium. An ember of stake from an idle funder counts only after the clock matures it, and a jetty of stale sponsors is dropped from quorum. Sybils get priced in capital, time.
